svg.aria-label: Above, the 56 baked directions of one species, 8 azimuths 45 degrees apart on each of 7 elevation rows from -65 to 85 degrees, drawn at their true spacing on the sphere: neighbours on the 85 degree row are about 4 degrees apart, on the 10 degree row about 44. Below, the handover by distance: a mesh tree stays a mesh until 560 m, an impostor becomes a mesh only inside 490 m, between the two a tree keeps last frame's owner, and the near pool reaches at least 592 m in every direction, inside its 600 m TREE_REACH.
